items.title: Breaking Down Anthropic's $1.4 Trillion IPO Valuation
items.title_ko: Breaking Down Anthropic's $1.4 Trillion IPO Valuation
items.summary_ko: Anthropic is preparing to price its initial public offering on November 18, targeting a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion and raising up to $90.4 billion to fund computing capacity for frontier AI models. Bloomberg’s Michael Shepard discusses the deal structure and whether the artificial intelligence sector can be said to have a circular financing dynamic.

items.title: Walker & Dunlop CEO on ‘27 Data Center Buildout Outlook
items.title_ko: Walker & Dunlop CEO on ‘27 Data Center Buildout Outlook
items.summary_ko: Willy Walker, Chairman and CEO of Walker & Dunlop, says modest daily interest-rate moves are unlikely to stall commercial real estate activity, though sharp jumps can temporarily halt deals while buyers and sellers reassess asset prices and financing costs. Rate expectations may also prompt some investors to act sooner rather than wait for further increases.
